effect: Eli's reply confirms the clinic link works, and Tin Row's call suggests a possible next step between networks.

mostWorthwhile.text: Load-testing both operating radios was the most worthwhile step: it turned the battery setup into a grounded plan for getting through the night.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the batteries to the matched power boxes felt like a predictable intermediate step, though the fuse explanation gave it a purpose.

surprise.text: The old wall adapter still had to be disconnected for both ends of the link to be independent.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, but most of the power sequence offered only one combination at a time, leaving little room for meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue, particularly to see how Latch and Tin Row connect their networks. The practical constraints were engaging, although I would hope for more choices than this chapter offered.
